# BodyDrive

Kind: component · Defined in [`src/logic/player/player.h`](../../../src/logic/player/player.h) · Described in `data/player.json`

A rigid body driven to a pose relative to another body (or the world) by force-limited velocity motors.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `anchor` | `entt::entity` | the body pushed against; null: the world |
| `position` | `glm::vec3` | target of the centre of mass, from the anchor's origin, in its frame |
| `rotation` | `glm::quat` | target rotation, in the anchor's frame |
| `velocity` | `glm::vec3` | feed forward, anchor frame, relative to it |
| `angular_velocity` | `glm::vec3` | feed forward, anchor frame |
| `gain` | `float` | part of the position error closed per step (0.607) |
| `angular_gain` | `float` | part of the angle error closed per step (0.183) |
| `max_force` | `float` | N per axis (10000) |
| `max_torque` | `float` | N m per axis (10000) |
| `rotate` | `bool` | false: only the position is driven |
| `error` | `glm::vec3` | written: target - centre of mass, world |
| `angular_error` | `float` | written: rad |
| `driven` | `bool` | written: the motor exists |

## Notes

Needs a dynamic RigidBody. The motor asks feed forward x max(1 - |error|, 0) + gain x error / step. Owned by BodyDrives; written by VRHands (hands) and Hold (held body, which also adds and removes it).

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: —. Written by: BodyDrives, Hold, PlayerSpawn, VRHands. Created by: Hold, PlayerSpawn. Destroyed by: Hold.

| System | Kind | Scope | Access | Where | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [BodyDrives](../systems/BodyDrives.md) | system | Host | **readwrite** | step, drop; signal on_destroy<BodyDrive> | target, gains, limits, anchor, rotate read; error, angular_error, driven written (driven false when the motor is dropped) |
| [Hold](../systems/Hold.md) | system | Host | **readwrite+create+destroy** | pick (emplace), step, drop (remove) | made on what is picked up (anchor the player, max_force / max_torque of the Holder); its target set every step; `driven` and `error` read to drop what is stuck |
| [PlayerSpawn](../systems/PlayerSpawn.md) | system | Host | **write+create** | init (makeVRPlayer) | each hand driven to its rest pose, anchored on the player |
| [VRHands](../systems/VRHands.md) | system | Host | **write** | step | anchor = the player; position, rotation, velocity, angular_velocity = the controller from the head turned by the play area (or the rest pose) |

## Side effects of those systems

- **[BodyDrives](../systems/BodyDrives.md)**
  - Connects `on_destroy<BodyDrive>` and `on_destroy<RigidBody>` in preinit, disconnects them in finish.
  - Creates a `SixDOFConstraint` (all axes free, motors in velocity mode) per ready drive, `AddConstraint`; `RemoveConstraint` when the drive, its body or its anchor goes, the anchor or `rotate` changes, or in finish.
  - Every physics step: force / torque limits and target velocities of the motors, `ActivateBody` of the body and its anchor.
- **[Hold](../systems/Hold.md)**
  - Narrow phase ray cast of `reach` along the view on a press of interact.
  - Sets the collision group of the held body; clears it and, on a throw, sets its linear velocity when it is dropped.
  - Adds and removes BodyDrive components (BodyDrives makes the constraint).
- **[PlayerSpawn](../systems/PlayerSpawn.md)**
  - Creates entities: the player (and its two hands for VR) and `props` box entities in init; one Ground entity in preinit with `ground: true`.
  - No physics bodies itself: RigidBody (a later system) makes the Jolt bodies of the RigidBody components it adds.
- **[VRHands](../systems/VRHands.md)**
  - At each physics step: `SetPositionAndRotation` + `SetLinearAndAngularVelocity` of a hand more than `failsafe` from its target; `AddForce` of its share (by mass) of the legs' force.
  - Sets the collision group of each hand body once.
